page.content:
Late Cretaceous apex theropod of western North America.

How Tyrannosaurus rex connects

  • Topic: Theropoda — Tyrannosaurus rex is a large coelurosaur theropod.
  • Item: Sue — Sue is a particular Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton, FMNH PR 2081.
  • Location: Hell Creek Formation — T. rex is the apex predator of the Hell Creek Formation.
  • Character: Barnum Brown — Barnum Brown collected the first recognized T. rex remains.
  • Item: Triceratops — T. rex and Triceratops are documented predator and prey in Hell Creek.

What is Tyrannosaurus rex?

Tyrannosaurus rex is the huge two-fingered predator of the Hell Creek and equivalent beds, known from skeletons such as Sue and from bite-marked bones of Triceratops and hadrosaurs.

Key threads lead to Theropoda, Sue, Hell Creek Formation, Barnum Brown and Triceratops.
